newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch insurer Aegon takes over US Providian Corp.
newsitem.headline: Dutch insurer Aegon takes over US Providian Corp.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Monday it had agreed to take over the insurance activities of the Providian Corporation of the United States in a deal worth worth $3.5 billion.

Aegon said the deal involved a tax-free exchange of shares, under which Providian shareholders would receive Aegon shares worth $2.62 billion and Aegon USA would take over loans worth $780 million and preferred stock worth $100 million.
The deal is expected to be concluded in the first half of 1997.
Providian Corp is based in Louisville, Kentucky and is active throughout the United States.
Aegon, based in the Hague, has total assets of around 150 billion guilders and operates in the Netherlands, UK, Spain and Hungary.
